Allah gave the children of Adam clothing to conceal their private parts and as adornment, but the clothing of righteousness is best.
Believing men and women are told to lower their gaze and guard their private parts, and women to cover their chests with headcovers and show adornment only to those listed.
Slaves and children must ask permission at three private times of day, children past puberty at all times, and women past menstruation may set aside outer garments without displaying adornment.
There is no blame on women before their fathers, sons, brothers, brothers' and sisters' sons, their women and those their right hands possess, and they are to fear Allah.
The Prophet is to tell his wives, daughters and believing women to draw their outer garments over themselves, so they will be known and not abused.
